item.tib: yi ge rgyal po ye nas byung / ye shes lnga ldan zhing khams dkar / ye nas gsal ba yi ge'i sgra / ye 'byung snying po mdo lnga'i gzungs
item.note: contains some fascinating letter mysticism. contains the 4 texts listed on fol. 1v1 as follows (numbers added): 166. man ngag gser zhun lung gi mdo. 167. kun bzang dgongs mdzad sgrib sbyong mdo. 168. padma dkar mo nyams gso'i mdo. 169. ltung ba bshags pa byang chub kyi mdo. the colophon to the 4th and final text says it was found by khye'u gnyan-thang at rtsang-po nu-ma.
